meta.description: Merged research dependency graph for game years 1800-2400 (12 lines), merged from partials/{kicl,pils,nhde}.json by tools/research/merge_graph_2400.py. Edges run prerequisite -> dependent; parents may be 0-600 ids (docs/research/deps/graph.json, plus the game's adopted 0-600 items), 600-1200 ids (docs/research/y600/deps/graph_1200.json) or 1200-1800 ids (docs/research/y1200/deps/graph_1800.json). proposed_year = target_year unless listed in year_adjustments_2400.json. earliest_feasible_year = critical path from year 0 over requires_all/requires_any using research_years (earlier parents keep their own value). serial_line_finish_year = one project at a time per line from year 1800, items in proposed_year order. Redated ids (registry_2400 redates) are placed here and must leave their earlier block at bake.
